🚨 ELECTION ISSUES: Alaska 

Official rolls as of Nov 3: 606,007 registered voters. The Census adult-citizen estimate is 538,813.

That's 112.5%, or 67,194 more registered names than adult citizens. https://t.co/iTYFMmUUpS

Democrats are going to attempt to END the Electoral College through the ‘National Popular Vote Interstate Compact’

Under the compact, participating states would award all their electors to the national popular vote winner instead of the candidate who won their state.

Democrats claim they have enough governors and legislatures to reach the threshold. 

This would make smaller and swing states irrelevant effectively rigging the system so Democrats could never lose again.

This is insane.

BREAKING: Trump and Netanyahu held an unusually heated phone call focused on Iran, that was "a shouting match from hell," Israeli officials tell Ynet.

During the call Netanyahu eagerly pushed Trump to resume major combat operations against Iran, while figures inside and outside the White House try to block it, Israeli officials say.

"Iran is working to renew the nuclear threat. The only way to permanently remove this existential threat is by toppling the ayatollah regime," Netanyahu also claimed during the call.

He warned Israel would soon face "international pressure to accept a nuclear Iran and the survival of the regime."

🔥 BOOM! Sen. Ashley Moody just went OFF on the Senate floor.
She demanded John Thune keep the Senate working 24/7 to push Trump’s nominees through before Dems take over: "WE'RE IN THE MAJORITY!"
